# Humberto Wilfredo Henríquez Benítez

> Systems engineer, data scientist and senior consultant in Microsoft Power Platform, data, automation and applied AI. Works remotely from San Salvador, El Salvador.

## Personal website

- [Home and ways to collaborate](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/#colaboracion): technical profile, team collaboration and working arrangements.
- [Professional profile](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/perfil/): education, career and professional approach.
- [Technical cases](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/perfil/#proyectos): Oficina Viva, Capturista Digital and data consolidation, with the scope of each case.
- [Laboratory](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/laboratorio/): 13 interactive demonstrations with synthetic data. They do not represent commercial outcomes achieved for clients.
- [Publications](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/publicaciones/): technical perspectives and articles authored by Humberto.
- [Contact](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/#contacto): external collaboration, defined projects and fully remote employment opportunities.

## Professional services through Optimatiza

- [Ongoing support](https://optimatiza.com/en/servicios-profesionales/): development, maintenance and improvement of solutions with shared priorities.
- [Support for consulting firms](https://optimatiza.com/en/servicios-profesionales/): senior collaboration within the team on Power Platform, data and automation.

Employment opportunities are discussed directly with Humberto. Professional services are managed through Optimatiza. Time commitment, start date, scope and terms are agreed on a case-by-case basis. This website does not advertise immediate availability, fixed rates or Microsoft Partner credentials.
